items.gist: The rite begins with mandala construction and trishula-based worship for putrakatva and related initiations.
The guru purifies the mandala and worships outer and gate deities, including the seven guru-lineage figures.
Deities are arranged across three trishulas from base to tip, completing worship through Parādevī's all-pervasion.
Lokapalas and other deities are worshipped as one Self, followed by bhogayaga and outer deity offerings.
The practitioner performs advaya bhavana through kumbha and related loci, revealing unified pervasion.
Special non-dual puja is offered, and the pasu is presented with discernment about eligibility.
Different grades of pasu are described, along with their physical signs and pacification.
The pasu's kalas are melted and its karmic bonds uprooted through yogic fire and lunar processes.
The purified essence is extracted and used to nourish the deity circle and extract the jiva.
The main tarpana unifies enjoyer and enjoyed, leading to the pasu's nirvana and siddhi.
Vira pasus and external pasus are distinguished, with their respective fruits and spiritual attainments.
The Lord graces all through sacrifice, while the rite is framed as beneficial rather than violent.
